Harassment complaint has been filed by a collector against a TVK MLA, triggering questions over the political fallout and the response of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay. As the complaint draws attention, the focus is now on how Vijay and the TVK leadership will respond to the allegations.
